cards.title: Parents: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Kids
cards.body: Rockstar's 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content in the series. It's genuinely not appropriate for children despite peer pressure.

cards.title: Should You Let Your Teen Play Grand Theft Auto?
cards.body: GTA VI raises familiar parenting questions about violence, maturity, and peer pressure. Parents need strategies for navigating these conversations with teens.

cards.title: Medical Sharenting: Who Owns Your Child's Story?
cards.body: Children often have no voice in decisions about sharing their medical histories online. They deserve space to decide how illness shapes their identity.

cards.title: How Professionals Overlook Intrafamilial Child Torture
cards.body: Children tortured by caregivers aren't always easy to identify in systems. Understanding the various ways abuse manifests helps professionals spot warning signs.

cards.title: Relative Says Hurtful Things About Your Child's Appearance?
cards.body: Tactless comments from family members can harm children's body image and self-esteem. Protection requires love, reassurance, empathy, and healthy perspective.

cards.title: How to Survive the Holidays With Difficult Relatives
cards.body: Warren Farrell's relationship tools can transform holiday arguments into connection opportunities. These strategies help navigate family conflict constructively.
